name: Heel Walking

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program

steps: Stand tall in a clear hallway or open room with good posture.
Lift your toes and the balls of both feet off the floor, balancing entirely on your heels.
Keep your ankles strongly dorsiflexed with your toes pulled high toward your shins.
Take small, controlled steps forward on your heels while maintaining your balance.
Walk forward for the designated duration or distance without letting your toes touch the ground.
coaching_cues: Stay tall with your chest up; avoid hunching your back or sticking your hips excessively backward.
Keep your toes lifted high throughout every single step to fire the anterior shin muscles.
Walk near a wall or railing if you need balance support.

sources.attribution: AAOS Foot and Ankle Conditioning Program
